classification_reason: The target and the room1/ch1 IV records share campaign date and naming cues, and some acquisitions share PXI2Slot2/ai0:1. No existing file explicitly maps the detector label, IV record, DAQ input, and target CH0 together.

evidence.fact: The target acquisition declares PXI2Slot2/ai0:1 and stores paired CH0/CH1 records.
evidence.supports: The target acquisition hardware/channel pair is known; it does not identify which physical detector is CH0.

evidence.fact: The adjacent-day r1ch12 acquisition uses the same PXI2Slot2/ai0:1 two-channel acquisition convention.
evidence.supports: A repeated acquisition setup for the r1ch12-labelled run; it does not establish detector serial or IV-channel identity.

evidence.fact: The target metadata records a 500 kS/s, 100000 samples/channel acquisition with paired channels.
evidence.supports: Target acquisition provenance only; no detector mapping field is present.

evidence.supports: A plausible same-day room1/ch1 candidate for the target's r1ch12 label, but not an explicit target linkage.

evidence.fact: The IV directory has no setting.xml, DAQ input string, detector serial/ID, hardware map, acquisition log, BOM, or channel cross-reference linking it to target CH0.

evidence.supports: Same-day channel-labelled IV activity exists, but it does not identify which target CH0/CH1 record corresponds to either IV directory.

evidence.fact: Nearby paired room1 ch1/ch2 acquisitions also declare PXI2Slot2/ai0:1.
evidence.supports: A recurring DAQ setup convention across nearby runs; it does not prove a physical detector mapping.

evidence.supports: Existence of potentially useful campaign thermal/DC data only; no target detector/channel applicability.
